From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: ProcureX: go-live prerequisites — contract & portal integration

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Before we flip the switch on the sandbox > production cutover, legal and ops have a few dependencies we need to lock down so the portal onboarding and PO flow are smooth. Outline below and a suggested timeline (we're targeting a 2/8 go-live if that still works on your side).

Attachments: MSA_redline_v3.pdf (our proposed edits), OrderForm_draft.xlsx (order form fields populated with your estimated SKU mapping)

Ask list / prerequisites:
- Legal: confirm whether ProcureX can accept our proposed clause in Section 7 (data processing / logging) or propose alternate language. See MSA_redline_v3.pdf (Kim will follow up).
- Portal: confirm required vendor fields for registration (tax id, remit, PO acknowledgement window, EDI/SFTP endpoint). If you have a vendor field spec export, please send.
- PO mapping: we need a sample PO XML (or EDI 850 snippet) so our connector can map line-level SKU and remit.
- Signature: do you prefer DocuSign for the MSA and Order Form? If yes we’ll initiate after legal sign-off.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- 1/19: share redline + portal field request (this email)
- 1/20–1/23: vendor provides portal spec + sample PO
- 1/24–1/26: legal finalizes MSA redline and returns comments
- 1/27–1/31: final DocuSign routing and ops preflight
- 2/8: targeted production cutover

Can you confirm the portal contact and whether ProcureX requires any specific onboarding paperwork besides the MSA/order form? I can schedule a short kickoff with our ops and legal.

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Appreciate the clarity. We can meet the 2/8 timeline if we get the redline and PO sample this week. Quick answers up front:
- Portal contact: Portal Ops (portal.ops@procurex.com) — cc'd. They handle field mapping and SFTP credentials.
- Signature: DocuSign preferred.
- Paperwork: we typically require a W-9 (US entity) and vendor remediation questionnaire for Payment Ops; we can ingest those into Ariba.

I've attached a Portal Field Spec export (procurex-portal-field-specs.xlsx) and a short sample PO XML snippet (included in the spreadsheet tab).

Two asks from our side:
1) Please confirm whether Redwood requires line-level UnitOfMeasure to be present — our Ariba export can include it but it has to be enabled on your side.
2) On the MSA, can your team flag any absolute liability caps? Our legal (cc'd Sarah Vincent from outside counsel) will want to reconcile with our procurement policy.

Thanks — I'll loop Portal Ops for the SFTP onboarding thread.

—Liam

Liam / Marissa —

Thanks for the field spec and the quick turnaround. I reviewed MSA_redline_v3.pdf and left inline comments; high-level items below. I attached a clean copy with comments (MSA_redline_comments.pdf).

High-level legal points you should expect from our side:
- Section 4.2 (Data Use): We propose that Redwood may log request metadata for performance and security, retained for a rolling 90 days. If ProcureX needs a shorter retention we can add a retention table to the Order Form.
- Section 7 (Liability): Redwood proposes a mutual cap equal to the total fees paid in prior 12 months. If ProcureX procurement policy requires a lower cap, please propose alternative language; we'll escalate to GC if needed.
- Section 9 (Subprocessors / Data Transfers): We require subprocessors to be listed in schedule B; if ProcureX requires vendor-by-vendor approval, that will impact timeline.
- PO acceptance window: We prefer 72 hours for PO acknowledgement but can be flexible — confirm Ariba accepts this as a default.

Operational asks for onboarding team:
- Provide SFTP hostname and testing credentials (Portal Ops) so our integration team can validate EDI ingestion.
- Provide sample EDI 850 and 997 flows if you plan to use EDI acknowledgements; otherwise confirm if Ariba-native PO JSON will be used.

Once ProcureX confirms liability cap position and the PO ack window, we can finalize the MSA and push to DocuSign.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
